briefdescription.para: Returns a new files child, built from each toolchain row whose argument matches the toolchain argument.

detaileddescription.para: A toolchain argument that matches no toolchain row sets the message.

parameterdescription.para: The parsed manifest.
The manifest file. Its folder is the base of the relative paths in the rows.
The toolchain argument from the command line. Empty when none is given.

briefdescription.para: Returns the construction of each family that holds a compiler manifest table, and writes the absent default files.

detaileddescription.para: The default files are written only into the folder of the default family, and each file is written only when it does not exist. A construction without a compiler manifest table is left out. A construction file that exists and does not parse sets the message.

parameterdescription.para: The files child that receives the message.

simplesect.para: The constructions of the families that hold a compiler manifest table.

memberdef.argsstring: (juce::ValueTree &files, const jam::MarkdownDocument &manifest, const jam::MarkdownDocument::Element &row, const juce::File &directory, const jam::MarkdownDocument &construction)
memberdef.name: addFiles

briefdescription.para: Adds the files of a C-family toolchain row, by the command of the row.

detaileddescription.para: A compiler manifest command adds the units. A dependency command adds the dependency records. Any other command adds nothing.

parameterdescription.para: The files child that receives the rows.
The parsed manifest.
The toolchain row.
The folder of the manifest.
The construction of the family. It holds the command words.

memberdef.argsstring: (juce::ValueTree &files, const jam::MarkdownDocument &manifest, const jam::MarkdownDocument::Element &row, const juce::File &directory, const jam::MarkdownDocument &construction)
memberdef.name: addUnits

briefdescription.para: Adds a file row for each unit of the compiler manifest in the build folder of the row.

detaileddescription.para: A row whose flag names no build folder adds nothing. When the compiler manifest exists, its path joins the compiler manifests of the files child before the file is parsed. A missing compiler manifest sets the message. A compiler manifest that does not parse sets the message.

parameterdescription.para: The files child that receives the rows.
The parsed manifest.
The toolchain row whose flag names the build folder.
The folder of the manifest. The build folder is relative to it.
The construction of the family. It holds the command words.

briefdescription.para: Adds a file row for one unit, when its file exists and no row has its path.

detaileddescription.para: The row gets the path, the family from the file extension, and the output path. A unit whose file does not exist sets the message.

parameterdescription.para: The files child that receives the row.
The parsed compiler manifest that holds the unit and its text.
The unit: its directory, file, output, and arguments.

briefdescription.para: Returns the arguments of a unit: its arguments array, or its command split into arguments.

detaileddescription.para: The command is split with jam::ChildProcess::getArguments when the unit has no arguments array.

parameterdescription.para: The parsed compiler manifest that holds the unit and its text.
The unit whose arguments are read.

memberdef.argsstring: (juce::ValueTree &files, const jam::MarkdownDocument &manifest, const jam::MarkdownDocument::Element &row, const juce::File &directory, const jam::MarkdownDocument &construction)
memberdef.name: addDependencies

briefdescription.para: Runs the dependency command of a row, and adds the records that it prints.

detaileddescription.para: The command runs in the folder of the manifest, and its output is read as the record. The call waits for the process to end. A zero exit adds the records, and the path of the record file in the build folder joins the dependency records of the files child. A nonzero exit sets the message, and no record is added.

parameterdescription.para: The files child that receives the rows.
The parsed manifest.
The toolchain row whose command and flag run.
The folder of the manifest, which is the working folder of the process.
The construction of the family. It holds the command words.

briefdescription.para: Returns the argument list of a dependency command: the command, the flag arguments, and the dependency flag.

parameterdescription.para: The command of the toolchain row.
The arguments of the flag of the row.
The dependency flag of the construction. Its arguments follow the flag arguments.

simplesect.para: The argument list of the process.

memberdef.argsstring: (juce::ValueTree &files, std::string_view record, const juce::File &buildDirectory, const juce::String &dependencyHead)
memberdef.name: addRecords

briefdescription.para: Adds the file rows and the dependency lists that a dependency record names.

parameterdescription.para: The files child that receives the rows.
The dependency record: the text that the command printed.

The text that marks the output in a head line of the record.

memberdef.name: addRecord

briefdescription.para: Reads one record of a dependency record, and returns the position of the next record.

detaileddescription.para: A head line that names an output links the indented lines after it to that unit as its dependencies. The unit is found by its output path.

parameterdescription.para: The files child that holds the units.
The paths of the file rows, in row order. A new dependency path is added here.
The dependency record.
The index of the first byte of the record.
The folder that the paths of the record are relative to.
The text that marks the output in a head line of the record.

simplesect.para: The index of the first byte after the record.

briefdescription.para: Returns the row index of a file, and appends a row when no row has its path.

detaileddescription.para: The paths hold the rows in row order, so an index of paths is the index of its row. A new row takes the family of the unit.

parameterdescription.para: The files child that receives a new row.
The paths of the rows, in row order. A new path is added here.
The unit whose family a new row takes.
The dependency file.

simplesect.para: The row index of the file.

briefdescription.para: Returns the argument that follows a directory flag.

parameterdescription.para: The arguments of the flag of a row.
The flag that names the directory.

simplesect.para: The argument after the first directoryFlag, or an empty string when none follows.

briefdescription.para: Builds the files child of the model from the toolchain rows of a manifest.

detaileddescription.para: A C-family toolchain row reads one of two sources. A compiler manifest is a JSON file in the build folder of the row, and it lists the units. A dependency row runs its command, and the record that the command prints lists the dependencies of each unit.
